counting_boundary: Seven eligible substantive actions count as six independent episodes; rolls 6 and 7 remain one repeated-stage appropriations episode, while the separate mineral and home-energy bills remain independent episodes inside two policy families. Vote direction never determines grouping.

episodes.meaningful_differences: Roll 6 jointly retained Divisions B-C; roll 7 passed the assembled cross-domain package. Roll 5 is excluded from this domain.
episodes.shared_objective: Retain the Energy-Water and Interior-Environment divisions, then pass the cross-domain FY2026 appropriations package.
episodes.why: The combined B-C retention and cross-domain final-passage boundary remain one shared review dependency and do not create member exceptions.

episodes.meaningful_differences: H.R. 4090 is a distinct enacted-action candidate from the separate supply-assessment bill in the same policy family.
episodes.shared_objective: Accelerate domestic mineral projects and direct federal land and resource agencies.
episodes.why: A separate bill and mechanism is an independent episode; recorded vote direction does not affect this assignment.

episodes.meaningful_differences: H.R. 3617 is a distinct supply-assessment and strategy bill within the Critical Mineral Supply policy family.
episodes.shared_objective: Assess critical-mineral supply vulnerability and require federal strategies, alternatives, recycling, and reporting.
episodes.why: A separate bill and mechanism is an independent episode; recorded vote direction does not affect this assignment.

episodes.meaningful_differences: H.R. 4626 is a distinct standards and rulemaking bill from the separate home-energy program-repeal bill.
episodes.shared_objective: Change the criteria governing future federal home-appliance efficiency rulemaking.
episodes.why: A separate bill and mechanism is an independent episode; recorded vote direction does not affect this assignment.

episodes.meaningful_differences: H.R. 4758 is a distinct program-repeal and rescission bill within the Home Energy Policy family.
episodes.shared_objective: Repeal specified home-energy rebate, training, and building-code assistance programs.
episodes.why: A separate bill and mechanism is an independent episode; recorded vote direction does not affect this assignment.

episodes.meaningful_differences: Single House-passage action with a unit-specific wildlife exception.
episodes.shared_objective: Limit federal land managers' authority to regulate lead ammunition or tackle on covered lands and waters.
episodes.why: Existing single-action relationship accurately represents the evidence.
